mainEntity.name: Does my petrol Discovery Sport have the 204PT engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Earlier petrol models used a different 2.0 turbo engine, so we check your VIN, model year and engine code before recommending any compatible replacement for your Discovery Sport.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 204PT engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a Discovery Sport 2.0 petrol engine supply only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Discovery Sport 204PT engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a turbo or cooling components, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204PT engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver Ingenium petrol engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their vehicle to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 204PT engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.
